active_flash_frontier.diagnosis: The prior route trace is segmented rather than a true token-major 0-to-47 chain: each post-attention linear segment starts from embeddings, so it cannot be used as a complete-chain teacher. A staged dense true-chain control established the valid two-token teacher (271 then 248045). The compact token-major body now matches that teacher across all 48 layers and seven token slots: 36 linear and 12 full-attention device-only banks remain alive; every inter-layer activation handoff is device-buffer based; all routes, state hashes, and both continuation terminals pass; no source reset/re-prefill occurs. Compact construction is 245,855,989,167 ns versus 2,098,365,358,834 ns staged-dense wall, while compact source loading is 5,866,532,000 ns versus 126,963,511,042 ns dense source loading. A separate no-snapshot replay then measured 1.4075 bounded replay TPS (710,493,146 ns/token mean) over three repeats; 600 dispatches/token and 690,784,807 ns/token GPU time make the cost physical rather than source or host diagnostics. The exact vectorized compact-MoE path passed the full control and produced 1.4879 bounded replay TPS (672,076,791 ns/token, one repeat), a 5.7% improvement. The control-side layer census puts 88% of seven-token GPU time in the 36 linear-attention layers. A layer-46 physical trace then isolated DeltaNet recurrence at 10,985,000 ns; a parallel value-column implementation reduced that primitive to 114,000 ns and halved layer host time while single-layer parity passed. Its reduction association changes full recurrent state hashes, however. Under an explicit non-bitwise candidate contract, the complete 48-layer body retained all device-only banks, matched all seven routed steps and both source-terminal continuations without reset/re-prefill, and reached 3.4168 bounded replay TPS (292,674,812 ns/token mean) over three repeats: 2.43x the exact baseline. That candidate cannot replace the exact resident until a separately earned tolerance/capability contract admits the changed state arithmetic.
active_flash_frontier.claim_boundary: The compact body and clean replay are bounded to the recorded teacher sequence. The replay is not capability-qualified sustained decode TPS, future-route coverage, complete EBPW, or resident-promotion evidence.
